identity_domains.entity: current match public entity serial; never internal instance id
identity_domains.event: per-view public stream sequence; never card identity
identity_domains.frame_card_reference: v3 window-local public ordinal, reissued from public field paths; never persistent registry serial

training_profiles.public-observation-v3: typed public snapshot and cursor-bound journal; missing capabilities remain features, never zero
training_profiles.semantic-complete-v3: all declared capabilities supported, all required semantic facts resolved

visibility: payload is viewer-specific; opponent hidden card identities and hidden linkages forbidden
frontier: only current v1 frame options; quota/cost/evaluation is never authority
migration: new closed observation envelope {profile,frame,input}; v1/v2 unchanged
history_scope: Every observed public boundary is reconciled; internal unobserved intermediate states are not a replay.
privacy: Public-zone moves use printing multisets. Hidden-to-hidden moves disclose count only. No physical card identifiers or hidden ordering.

evaluation_scope.energy: basic only; unreviewed board sources fail closed before damage getter dispatch
evaluation_scope.damage: conditional main hit only; excludes subsequent effect damage and counters
evaluation_scope.predicates: defender prevention predicates before attack-specific ignores; not final immunity or legality proof
